no_pick_reason: Ingen køb i dag, fordi de store nyheder allerede er priset ind: Intel-chokket og chipfaldet ramte kursen i premarket 30. oktober, Microsoft- og Alphabet-reaktionerne stammer fra efter-hours-handlen 28. oktober, og Amazon- og Lilly-resultaterne kunne ikke verificeres, mens Exxons resultattidspunkt er uklart.

headlines.headline: Intel shares plunge about 25% on Q4 guidance miss and PC market warning; Dell, AMD and Nvidia also fall
AMD shares fall 6.5% premarket after Intel's disappointing outlook raises PC and semiconductor demand concerns
Chip stocks slide premarket on Intel warning, Amazon results and hyperscaler capex concerns
Microsoft Azure revenue up 48% to $33.17B; capex hits $39.37B and 2026 capex outlook raised to about $175B
Alphabet Q3 revenue $127.6B and Google Cloud up 103% to $30.7B, but EPS of $2.12 misses and shares fall about 8% after hours
Amazon Q3 2026 earnings preview: report due after the close Oct 29, consensus EPS $2.01, revenue $202.1B, AWS $45.4B
Eli Lilly scheduled to report Q3 2026 financial results on October 29, 2026 (results content not retrieved)
Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00% in 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissent for a hike
Warsh press conference: Fed stays on hold; 10-year yield rises to about 5.04%, stocks muted
ExxonMobil to hold 3Q 2026 earnings call on Friday, October 30
